+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""pipeline/local_judge.py: the GPU0 LOCAL JUDGE (orchestrator 2026-11-13 '07:28' item 2; law L-aa TIME SAVERS ARE
+AUTOMATIC; law L-x ULTRON FIRST).
+
+WHAT: the pin-stage verdicts that today go to vendors (step A, the L-s context reading of each moment; the clips-alone
+verdict; the angle step) asked of a model on Ultron's GPU0, with the vendor's own prompt, max_tokens and seed.
+
+THE MODEL: gemma3:27b on the GPU0 Ollama (:11434), num_ctx 16384 (story_semantics.LocalLLM: temperature 0, JSON
+format). Ultron holds four Ollama models: gemma3:27b (17 GB), qwen3-coder:30b (18 GB, a coding model, pinned to GPU1),
+deepseek-coder-v2:16b (8.9 GB, a coding model, GPU1's) and llama3.1:70b (42 GB: does not fit a 24 GB card). gemma3:27b
+is the strongest general instruction model that fits GPU0, it already holds a measured REQUIREMENT_MIB in gpu0.py
+(20600 MiB at this context), and it is the model of the editorial gate and the clip scorer, so no new weights are
+pulled.
+
+USE, until the orchestrator rules otherwise: a PRE-FILTER only. It may reject cheaply and rank; a clip or line-up it
+passes still gets the different-vendor verdict the laws require (L-s, L-x: never one model). It can save calls, never
+lower the bar. It counts only after its replay (local_judge_compare.py) is reported.
+
+GPU0 (law L-r): every call runs under the GPU0 lease, in batches of at most BATCH calls; each batch ends with
+gpu0.release_all (the model unloaded, GPU0 left as found) and the lease released. A render always comes first: before
+EVERY call the judge checks YIELD_FLAG; whoever launches a render touches it, waits for the lease to come free, starts
+the render and removes the flag once the render holds the lease. A held lease (LeaseBusy) is waited out between
+batches, never forced. Outputs are appended one JSON line per job, so a stopped replay resumes where it stopped.
+
+Usage: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 python3 pipeline/local_judge.py replay [--since ISO] [--out PATH]"""
+import argparse
+import glob
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+import time
+
+PIPELINE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
+sys.path.insert(0, PIPELINE)
+
+MODEL = "gemma3:27b"
+YIELD_FLAG = os.environ.get("PP_GPU0_YIELD", "/tmp/pulse_gpu0.yield")
+OWNER = "local judge (integrator, GPU0 pre-filter)"
+BATCH = 8
+REPLIES = "/home/ultron/worktrees/pp-selectid/tests/package/fixtures/replies"   # the builder's recorded exchanges
+FAMILIES = (("clips_alone", "You watch a short video made ONLY of these clips"),       # the clips-alone verdict
+            ("angle", "You are the editor of PBX MAX"),                                # the angle step
+            ("step_a", "You read transcripts of Bitcoin videos. For each EXCERPT"))   # step A (L-s context)
+SINCE = "2026-11-13T04:00"            # the first ledger_2026* build of the night (ledger_20261113_0405)
+
+
+def family(prompt):
+    head = " ".join(str(prompt).split())
+    return next((k for k, w in FAMILIES if head.startswith(w)), None)
+
+
+def prompt_id(prompt, max_tokens, seed):
+    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps([prompt, max_tokens, seed]).encode()).hexdigest()[:20]
+
+
+def recorded(since=SINCE, replies=REPLIES):
+    """The builder's recorded vendor exchanges of the three families since `since` (UTC ISO):
+    [{id, family, prompt, max_tokens, seed, vendor: [{backend, text, recorded_at, path}]}], one job per distinct
+    (prompt, max_tokens, seed), every vendor answer to it kept."""
+    jobs = {}
+    for p in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(replies, "*", "*.json"))):
+        try:
+            with open(p) as f:
+                r = json.load(f)
+        except (OSError, ValueError):
+            continue
+        fam = family(r.get("prompt", ""))
+        if fam is None or (r.get("recorded_at") or "") < since or not isinstance(r.get("text"), str):
+            continue
+        jid = prompt_id(r["prompt"], r.get("max_tokens"), r.get("seed"))
+        j = jobs.setdefault(jid, {"id": jid, "family": fam, "prompt": r["prompt"], "max_tokens": r.get("max_tokens"),
+                                  "seed": r.get("seed"), "vendor": []})
+        j["vendor"].append({"backend": r.get("backend"), "text": r["text"], "recorded_at": r.get("recorded_at"),
+                            "path": os.path.relpath(p, replies)})
+    order = {k: i for i, (k, _) in enumerate(FAMILIES)}
+    return sorted(jobs.values(), key=lambda j: (order[j["family"]], j["id"]))
+
+
+def render_wants_gpu0():
+    return os.path.exists(YIELD_FLAG)
+
+
+def done_ids(out):
+    """Jobs with an ANSWER in `out` (a line whose call failed is not done: the next run asks it again; batch 61 C2).
+    A truncated line (a crash mid-write) is skipped, never a crash."""
+    if not os.path.exists(out):
+        return set()
+    done = set()
+    with open(out) as f:
+        for line in f:
+            try:
+                r = json.loads(line)
+            except ValueError:
+                continue
+            if r.get("text") is not None:
+                done.add(r["id"])
+    return done
+
+
+def run(jobs, out, batch=BATCH, log=print, idle_s=20.0):
+    """Ask MODEL every job not yet answered in `out` (JSONL), BATCH calls per lease, each job at most once per run (a
+    failed call waits for the next run). Yields GPU0 to a render: YIELD_FLAG is checked before taking the lease, again
+    once it is held (batch 61 C1: a render that asked in between gets it back at once, nothing loaded), and before
+    every call. A held lease is waited out between batches. Returns the number of answers written."""
+    import gpu0
+    import story_semantics as sm
+    written, tried = 0, set()
+    while True:
+        todo = [j for j in jobs if j["id"] not in done_ids(out) and j["id"] not in tried]
+        if not todo:
+            return written
+        if render_wants_gpu0():
+            log(f"  yielding GPU0 to a render ({YIELD_FLAG}); {len(todo)} jobs left")
+            time.sleep(idle_s)
+            continue
+        try:
+            with gpu0.lease(OWNER, wait_s=0):
+                if render_wants_gpu0():                              # it asked while the lease was being taken
+                    continue
+                llm = sm.LocalLLM(model=MODEL).start()
+                try:
+                    for j in todo[:batch]:
+                        if render_wants_gpu0():
+                            break
+                        tried.add(j["id"])
+                        t0, err, text = time.time(), None, None
+                        try:
+                            text = llm._post(j["prompt"], j["max_tokens"] or 2000, j["seed"] if j["seed"] is not None else 7)
+                        except gpu0.Gpu0Stop:
+                            raise
+                        except Exception as e:                       # recorded; asked again by the NEXT run only
+                            err = f"{type(e).__name__}: {str(e)[:300]}"
+                        with open(out, "a") as f:
+                            f.write(json.dumps({"id": j["id"], "family": j["family"], "model": MODEL,
+                                                "digest": getattr(llm, "digest", None), "text": text, "error": err,
+                                                "seconds": round(time.time() - t0, 1),
+                                                "at": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime())}) + "\n")
+                        written += 1
+                        log(f"  {j['family']:11s} {j['id']} {time.time() - t0:5.1f} s{' ERROR ' + err if err else ''}")
+                finally:
+                    gpu0.release_all()                               # GPU0 left as found before the lease goes
+        except gpu0.LeaseBusy as e:
+            log(f"  GPU0 lease busy ({e}); waiting")
+            time.sleep(idle_s)
+
+
+def main(argv=None):
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    ap.add_argument("cmd", choices=["replay", "list"])
+    ap.add_argument("--since", default=SINCE)
+    ap.add_argument("--out", default=os.path.join(os.path.dirname(PIPELINE), "data", "local_judge", "replay_answers.jsonl"))
+    a = ap.parse_args(argv)
+    jobs = recorded(a.since)
+    counts = {k: sum(j["family"] == k for j in jobs) for k, _ in FAMILIES}
+    print(f"{len(jobs)} recorded prompts since {a.since}: {counts}")
+    if a.cmd == "list":
+        return 0
+    if os.environ.get("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES") != "0":
+        sys.exit("the local judge runs on GPU0: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 (law L-r)")
+    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(a.out), exist_ok=True)
+    with open(a.out + ".jobs.json", "w") as f:                          # what was asked, for the comparison
+        json.dump(jobs, f)
+    n = run(jobs, a.out)
+    print(f"done: {n} answers written to {a.out}")
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""pipeline/local_judge_compare.py: the local judge's replay measured against tonight's recorded vendor verdicts
+(orchestrator 2026-11-13 '07:28' item 2: "PROVE IT BEFORE IT COUNTS ... report agreement per verdict type, with every
+disagreement listed"). CPU only. The verdicts are read with the BUILDER'S OWN rules, imported from the pp-selectid
+worktree in this process alone (its pipeline directory first on sys.path, this one's removed):
+- step A: context_integrity._strict with A_KEYS, exactly the prompt's labels; a moment passes when a_failures() is
+  empty. Agreement = the same pass / fail, and the same failing rules.
+- the clips-alone verdict: package.medley's contract (through_line, clips = the prompt's labels rated 1-5, joins =
+  package.joins of them, each {followable: bool, why: str}); ok = a stated through-line (>= 4 words, not NO_LINE),
+  every clip >= COHERENCE_MIN, at most LY_MAX_BRIDGES joins not followable. Agreement = the same ok, the same flagged
+  joins, the same followable per join.
+- the angle step (a WRITER: its "agreement" is overlap, stated as such): the prompt's own rules (4-8 known ids, the
+  hook first, at least 3 channels); per vendor angle the best moment-set Jaccard against the local angles, and whether
+  a local hook is a vendor hook.
+For a PRE-FILTER the direction matters and is reported apart: local FAIL where the vendor PASSES would drop a good
+candidate before the vendor sees it (the costly error); local PASS where the vendor FAILS is harmless (the vendor
+still judges it).
+Usage: python3 pipeline/local_judge_compare.py ANSWERS.jsonl REPORT_PREFIX"""
+import json
+import os
+import re
+import subprocess
+import sys
+
+PIPELINE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
+BUILDER = "/home/ultron/worktrees/pp-selectid/pipeline"
+sys.path = [BUILDER] + [p for p in sys.path if os.path.abspath(p or ".") != PIPELINE]
+import context_integrity as CI  # noqa: E402  (the builder's)
+import package as P  # noqa: E402  (the builder's)
+
+
+def step_a(job, text):
+    labels = re.findall(r'<excerpt label="([^"]+)"', job["prompt"])
+    A = CI._strict(text, {"excerpts"}, {"excerpts": CI.A_KEYS})
+    by = {e["label"]: e for e in A["excerpts"] if isinstance(e.get("label"), str)}
+    if set(by) != set(labels) or len(A["excerpts"]) != len(labels):
+        raise ValueError(f"step A must answer exactly the labels {labels}")
+    return {lb: CI.a_failures(by[lb]) for lb in labels}
+
+
+def clips_alone(job, text):
+    labs = re.findall(r'CLIP label="([^"]+)"', job["prompt"])
+    js = P.joins(labs)
+    v = json.loads(text.strip())
+    if not isinstance(v, dict) or set(v) != {"through_line", "clips", "joins"} or not isinstance(v["clips"], dict) \
+            or set(v["clips"]) != set(labs) or any(type(x) is not int or not 1 <= x <= 5 for x in v["clips"].values()) \
+            or not isinstance(v["joins"], dict) or set(v["joins"]) != set(js) \
+            or any(not isinstance(x, dict) or set(x) != {"followable", "why"} or type(x["followable"]) is not bool
+                   or not isinstance(x["why"], str) for x in v["joins"].values()):
+        raise ValueError("clips-alone verdict out of contract")
+    tl = v["through_line"] if isinstance(v["through_line"], str) else ""
+    flagged = [j for j in js if v["joins"][j]["followable"] is False]
+    ok = bool(tl.strip()) and not P.NO_LINE.search(tl) and len(tl.split()) >= 4 and \
+        min(v["clips"].values()) >= P.COHERENCE_MIN and len(flagged) <= P.LY_MAX_BRIDGES
+    return {"ok": ok, "flagged": flagged, "followable": {j: v["joins"][j]["followable"] for j in js},
+            "clips": v["clips"], "through_line": tl}
+
+
+def angle(job, text):
+    cands = {m.group(1): m.group(2).strip() for m in re.finditer(r"id=([0-9a-f]{20}) \| ([^|]+)\|", job["prompt"])}
+    v = json.loads(text.strip())
+    out = []
+    for a in (v.get("angles") or []) if isinstance(v, dict) else []:
+        ms = a.get("moments") if isinstance(a, dict) else None
+        valid = (isinstance(ms, list) and 4 <= len(ms) <= 8 and len(set(ms)) == len(ms) and all(m in cands for m in ms)
+                 and a.get("hook") == ms[0] and len({cands[m] for m in ms}) >= 3 and isinstance(a.get("angle"), str))
+        out.append({"valid": bool(valid), "moments": list(ms) if isinstance(ms, list) else [], "hook": a.get("hook")
+                    if isinstance(a, dict) else None, "angle": a.get("angle") if isinstance(a, dict) else None})
+    if not out:
+        raise ValueError("no angles")
+    return out
+
+
+READ = {"step_a": step_a, "clips_alone": clips_alone, "angle": angle}
+
+
+def jaccard(a, b):
+    a, b = set(a), set(b)
+    return len(a & b) / len(a | b) if a | b else 0.0
+
+
+def main(answers, prefix):
+    with open(answers + ".jobs.json") as f:
+        jobs = {j["id"]: j for j in json.load(f)}
+    local = {}
+    with open(answers) as f:
+        for line in f:
+            try:
+                r = json.loads(line)
+            except ValueError:
+                continue
+            if r.get("text") is not None or r["id"] not in local:          # an answer outranks a failed call
+                local[r["id"]] = r
+    rep = {fam: {"jobs": 0, "local_out_of_contract": [], "vendor_out_of_contract": 0, "vendor_answers_not_compared": [],
+                 "seconds": []} for fam in READ}
+    rows = {fam: [] for fam in READ}
+    for jid, job in jobs.items():
+        if jid not in local:
+            continue
+        fam, r = job["family"], rep[job["family"]]
+        r["jobs"] += 1
+        r["seconds"].append(local[jid]["seconds"])
+        try:
+            lv = READ[fam](job, local[jid]["text"] or "")
+        except Exception as e:
+            r["local_out_of_contract"].append({"id": jid, "why": f"{type(e).__name__}: {str(e)[:160]}",
+                                               "error": local[jid].get("error")})
+            continue
+        # ONE vendor answer per job (batch 61 C3 / C4): the earliest that reads in contract, so every count is per
+        # moment / line-up / angle prompt; any other answer to the same prompt is listed, not counted
+        cmp_ = None
+        for vend in sorted(job["vendor"], key=lambda v: v.get("recorded_at") or ""):
+            try:
+                vv = READ[fam](job, vend["text"])
+            except Exception:
+                r["vendor_out_of_contract"] += 1
+                continue
+            if cmp_ is None:
+                cmp_ = {"id": jid, "backend": vend["backend"], "vendor": vv, "local": lv}
+            else:
+                r["vendor_answers_not_compared"].append({"id": jid, "backend": vend["backend"]})
+        if cmp_ is not None:
+            rows[fam].append(cmp_)
+    # step A: per moment
+    a = rep["step_a"]
+    a.update(moments=0, same_verdict=0, same_rules=0, local_fail_vendor_pass=[], local_pass_vendor_fail=[],
+             rule_disagreements=[])
+    for x in rows["step_a"]:
+        for lb, vr in x["vendor"].items():
+            lr = x["local"][lb]
+            a["moments"] += 1
+            a["same_verdict"] += (not vr) == (not lr)
+            a["same_rules"] += sorted(vr) == sorted(lr)
+            d = {"id": x["id"], "label": lb, "vendor": x["backend"], "vendor_rules": vr, "local_rules": lr}
+            if lr and not vr:
+                a["local_fail_vendor_pass"].append(d)
+            elif vr and not lr:
+                a["local_pass_vendor_fail"].append(d)
+            elif sorted(vr) != sorted(lr):
+                a["rule_disagreements"].append(d)
+    # clips alone: per verdict and per join
+    c = rep["clips_alone"]
+    c.update(verdicts=0, same_ok=0, same_flagged=0, joins=0, same_join=0, local_fail_vendor_pass=[],
+             local_pass_vendor_fail=[], flag_disagreements=[], join_disagreements=[], rating_abs_diff=[])
+    for x in rows["clips_alone"]:
+        v, l = x["vendor"], x["local"]
+        c["verdicts"] += 1
+        c["same_ok"] += v["ok"] == l["ok"]
+        c["same_flagged"] += sorted(v["flagged"]) == sorted(l["flagged"])
+        d = {"id": x["id"], "vendor": x["backend"], "vendor_ok": v["ok"], "local_ok": l["ok"], "vendor_flagged":
+             v["flagged"], "local_flagged": l["flagged"], "vendor_clips": v["clips"], "local_clips": l["clips"]}
+        if l["ok"] and not v["ok"]:
+            c["local_pass_vendor_fail"].append(d)
+        elif v["ok"] and not l["ok"]:
+            c["local_fail_vendor_pass"].append(d)
+        elif sorted(v["flagged"]) != sorted(l["flagged"]):
+            c["flag_disagreements"].append(d)
+        for j, f in v["followable"].items():
+            c["joins"] += 1
+            c["same_join"] += f == l["followable"][j]
+            if f != l["followable"][j]:
+                c["join_disagreements"].append({"id": x["id"], "join": j, "vendor": f, "local": l["followable"][j]})
+        c["rating_abs_diff"] += [abs(v["clips"][k] - l["clips"][k]) for k in v["clips"]]
+    # angle: overlap
+    g = rep["angle"]
+    g.update(compared=0, local_valid_angles=0, local_angles=0, best_jaccard=[], first_jaccard=[], hook_shared=0,
+             first_hook_same=0, rows=[])
+    for x in rows["angle"]:
+        vv = [y for y in x["vendor"] if y["valid"]]
+        lv = [y for y in x["local"] if y["valid"]]
+        g["local_angles"] += len(x["local"])
+        g["local_valid_angles"] += len(lv)
+        if not vv:
+            continue
+        g["compared"] += 1
+        best = [max((jaccard(y["moments"], z["moments"]) for z in lv), default=0.0) for y in vv]
+        g["best_jaccard"] += best
+        g["first_jaccard"].append(jaccard(vv[0]["moments"], lv[0]["moments"]) if lv else 0.0)
+        shared = bool({y["hook"] for y in vv} & {z["hook"] for z in lv})
+        g["hook_shared"] += shared
+        g["first_hook_same"] += bool(lv) and vv[0]["hook"] == lv[0]["hook"]
+        g["rows"].append({"id": x["id"], "vendor": x["backend"], "vendor_angles": len(vv), "local_valid": len(lv),
+                          "best_jaccard": [round(b, 2) for b in best], "hook_shared": shared,
+                          "vendor_hooks": [y["hook"] for y in vv], "local_hooks": [z["hook"] for z in lv]})
+    rep["prefilter_rules"] = prefilter_rules(rows)
+    for fam in READ:
+        s = rep[fam].pop("seconds")
+        rep[fam]["local_seconds"] = {"n": len(s), "mean": round(sum(s) / len(s), 1) if s else None,
+                                     "max": max(s) if s else None}

+    rep["_meta"] = {"model": next((r.get("model") for r in local.values()), None),
+                    "digest": next((r.get("digest") for r in local.values() if r.get("digest")), None),
+                    "builder_rules": f"{BUILDER} @ {head.stdout.strip() if head.returncode == 0 else 'unknown'}",
+                    "answers": answers}
+    with open(prefix + ".json", "w") as f:
+        json.dump(rep, f, indent=1)
+    print(json.dumps(summary(rep), indent=1))
+    return rep
+

+def prefilter_rules(rows):
+    """Candidate PRE-FILTER rules measured on the recorded cases (law L-aa: an A/B on recorded cases). A local REJECT
+    skips the vendor verdict: 'saved' = it rejected what the vendor also rejected; 'lost' = it rejected what the vendor
+    PASSED (a good candidate never seen by the vendor). Only a rule with lost == 0 can be proposed for use."""
+    out = {"step_a": {}, "clips_alone": {}}
+    rules = sorted({r for x in rows["step_a"] for lb in x["local"] for r in x["local"][lb]})
+    for rule in rules:                                      # reject a moment when the local judge fails THIS rule
+        saved = lost = 0
+        for x in rows["step_a"]:
+            for lb, vr in x["vendor"].items():
+                if rule in x["local"][lb]:
+                    saved += bool(vr)
+                    lost += not vr
+        out["step_a"][f"local fails {rule}"] = {"saved": saved, "lost": lost}
+    for t in (1, 2, 3):                                     # reject a line-up when the local judge rates a clip <= t
+        saved = lost = 0
+        for x in rows["clips_alone"]:
+            if min(x["local"]["clips"].values()) <= t:
+                saved += not x["vendor"]["ok"]
+                lost += x["vendor"]["ok"]
+        out["clips_alone"][f"a local clip rating <= {t}"] = {"saved": saved, "lost": lost}
+    saved = lost = 0
+    for x in rows["clips_alone"]:                           # reject a line-up when the local judge states no line
+        if not x["local"]["through_line"].strip() or P.NO_LINE.search(x["local"]["through_line"]):
+            saved += not x["vendor"]["ok"]
+            lost += x["vendor"]["ok"]
+    out["clips_alone"]["no local through-line"] = {"saved": saved, "lost": lost}
+    return out
+
+
+def pct(n, d):
+    return f"{n}/{d} ({100.0 * n / d:.0f} %)" if d else "0/0"
+
+
+def summary(rep):
+    a, c, g = rep["step_a"], rep["clips_alone"], rep["angle"]
+    mean = lambda xs: round(sum(xs) / len(xs), 2) if xs else None
+    return {"step_a": {"prompts": a["jobs"], "local_out_of_contract": len(a["local_out_of_contract"]),

+                            "mean_rating_abs_diff": mean(c["rating_abs_diff"]), "local_s": c["local_seconds"]},
+            "angle": {"compared": g["compared"], "local_out_of_contract": len(g["local_out_of_contract"]),
+                      "local_valid_angles": f"{g['local_valid_angles']}/{g['local_angles']}",

+yield flag stops the next call, a held lease is waited out, every batch releases GPU0 even when a call fails, a GPU
+stop is never swallowed, a stopped replay resumes); and the comparison read with the builder's own rules (in its own
+process, as it runs)."""

+def rec(d, name, prompt, text, at="2026-11-13T05:00:00Z", backend="xai:grok", max_tokens=1200, seed=7):
+    os.makedirs(os.path.join(d, name[:2]), exist_ok=True)
+    with open(os.path.join(d, name[:2], name + ".json"), "w") as f:
+        json.dump({"role": "x", "backend": backend, "prompt": prompt, "text": text, "recorded_at": at,
+                   "max_tokens": max_tokens, "seed": seed}, f)
+
+
+class TestRecorded(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_three_families_since_the_cutoff_one_job_per_prompt(self):
+        d = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="lj_rec_")
+        self.addCleanup(shutil.rmtree, d)
+        rec(d, "aa1", "You watch a short video made ONLY of these clips ...", "{}")
+        rec(d, "aa2", "You watch a short video made ONLY of these clips ...", "{}", backend="heimdall:x")  # same prompt
+        rec(d, "bb1", "You are the editor of PBX MAX: ...", "{}")
+        rec(d, "cc1", "You read  transcripts of Bitcoin videos.\nFor each EXCERPT below", "{}")  # whitespace-normalised
+        rec(d, "dd1", "You are PBX MAX, the host of ...", "{}")                                   # a writer: not judged
+        rec(d, "ee1", "You watch a 60-second video. Here is everything ...", "{}")                 # coherence: not here
+        rec(d, "ff1", "You watch a short video made ONLY of these clips (old)", "{}", at="2026-11-12T20:00:00Z")
+        jobs = J.recorded(since="2026-11-13T04:00", replies=d)

+        self.assertEqual(sorted(v["backend"] for v in jobs[0]["vendor"]), ["heimdall:x", "xai:grok"])

+class FakeLLM:
+    def __init__(self, model=None):

+    def test_a_render_asking_while_the_lease_is_taken_gets_it_back_with_nothing_loaded(self):   # batch 61 C1
